en.headline: Shing-Tung Yau leads launch of Asian Mathematics Alliance in Hong Kong
en.dek: The Fields Medal winner said the new body would focus on pure mathematics, applied maths, statistics and artificial intelligence, drawing on Hong Kong’s bilingual strengths.
body: The Asian Mathematics Alliance was established in Hong Kong under the leadership of Fields Medal winner Shing-Tung Yau, who invited dozens of senior and younger mathematicians for research and regular exchanges.

In an interview with RTHK, Yau said Asia needed such an organisation, similar to those in the United States and Europe, to pool talent from the region. He noted Hong Kong’s advantages, including strong mainland investment in mathematics research and a good English-speaking environment that removes language barriers for overseas scholars.

The alliance will focus on pure mathematics, applied mathematics, statistics and artificial intelligence. Yau described AI as inseparable from mathematics and said large-scale data in the AI era required collaborative efforts by mathematicians to advance technology.

zh.headline: 丘成桐牽頭在港成立亞洲數學聯盟 聚焦純數應用數學統計及AI
zh.dek: 菲爾茲獎得主表示新組織將匯聚亞洲數學人才，香港憑英語環境及背靠內地優勢成為合適地點。
body: 由菲爾茲獎得主丘成桐牽頭的亞洲數學聯盟在香港成立，邀請數十名資深數學家及年輕學者來港進行學術研究及定期交流。
丘成桐接受香港電台專訪時表示，美國及歐洲均有數學學會帶領研究發展，亞洲亦需要類似組織匯聚各地人才。他指香港有優勢，包括內地對數學研究的大量資源投入，以及良好的英語環境，令海外學者在港工作生活沒有語言障礙。
聯盟將聚焦基礎純數學、應用數學、統計學及人工智能四大範疇。丘成桐說人工智能本身是數學的一部分，兩者密不可分，AI時代的龐大數據需要不同數學學者共同處理，以推動科技發展。
